candidates: the nth time the search expands a goal it receives the nth candidate set drawn for that goal in the task, keyed by the goal's printed text without its case tag and with metavariable numbers erased (search_harness.canonical_goal): first the sets search-v0.11 recorded for the task, in their order, then the sets this experiment drew for the task in earlier attempts, then fresh draws, made as in search-v0.11 and logged

checks.C45: every unit is final, and no latest row records an error
checks.C46: the typed export fails on fewer than 1% of the states the search exports
checks.C47: every candidate set the search takes as seeded is one search-v0.11 recorded, or an earlier attempt of the unit drew, for that goal and occurrence in the task

developmentChecksBeforeRegistration: none on these tasks: scripts/test_search_goals_holdout.py tests the seeding, the attempt rule with its candidate bank, and the summary without Lean; the unit process was run once on one of search-v0.10's tasks (Polynomial.monomial_mem_lifts), seeded with the sets search-v0.10 recorded for its first goal only so that later expansions drew from the server: proved in 6 expansions, 1 seeded and 5 drawn sets, no export failure
execution: each task's unit in its own Python process; 4 units at a time, each started only while at least 15 GB of commit charge is left and 45 s after the previous start; search-v0.11's attempt rule (a unit that raised is repeated up to 3 attempts, one whose search was not constructed or was abandoned is repeated once, and the latest row counts), a repeat reusing every candidate set drawn for the unit before

hypotheses.H112: the coupled-group search (search-v0.11's rows) does not prove significantly more tasks than the independent-goal search within 48 expansions (one-sided sign test on the tasks exactly one of them proves, Holm's procedure at 0.05 over this test and H113's)
hypotheses.H113: the independent-goal search proves significantly more tasks than the whole-state search (search-v0.11's rows) within 48 expansions (one-sided sign test on the tasks exactly one of them proves, Holm's procedure at 0.05 over this test and H112's)
hypotheses.H114: the upper limit of the 95% interval (Newcombe's hybrid score interval for paired proportions) for the group search's proof rate minus the independent-goal search's is below 1 point, about the gain search-v0.11 estimated for the group search over the whole-state search

kind: an ablation on search-v0.11's tasks and candidates, whose results were known at registration: the third search of search-v0.10, paired with search-v0.11's two
limits: search-v0.11's two searches ran on 2026-10-10 to 12 and this search runs later, on the same machine, REPL, Mathlib and model; where it reaches a goal or an occurrence search-v0.11 did not draw, its candidates are fresh samples, so the pairing matches candidates only where the searches meet
pairing: over the tasks this search states, its latest row against search-v0.11's latest rows of the same task: proved within 48 expansions by both, by one only, or by neither
proposer: BFS-Prover-V2-7B in Q8_0 as in search-v0.11, served on port 8091: 16 completions at temperature 1.0, at most 64 tokens, the first goal followed by ':::', duplicates dropped
question: on search-v0.11's held-out tasks and with its candidates, does the coupled-group search prove more than the independent-goal search, and the independent-goal search more than the whole-state search, at 48 expansions
search: search_typed.and_or_search, search-v0.10's independent-goal search: single goals merged by the typed key, a candidate that changes another goal discarded as entangled; breadth-first, 48 expansions, in a fresh REPL, run through search_typed_v2 so that a lost session abandons it

tasks.rule: search-v0.11's tasks whose latest rows are constructed in both its searches, in its order

tests: H112 and H113 by one-sided sign tests on the tasks exactly one of the two searches proves, with Holm's procedure at 0.05 over the two; H114 by the upper limit of Newcombe's 95% hybrid score interval; percentile intervals resampling modules are reported beside them and do not decide
